description: Shared Renovate preset for nf-* pipelines and nf-sub-* subworkflows. Tracks nf-mod-* and nf-sub-* versions via the modules.versions file at the repo root, with semver-aware propagation rules.

customManagers.description: Track nf-mod-* and nf-sub-* versions declared in modules.versions. Each line: nf-mod-<name>=v<MAJOR>.<MINOR>.<PATCH> or nf-sub-<name>=... A subworkflow is pinned and propagated exactly like a module. The pattern is anchored on the preceding newline, not on ^/$: Renovate does not match line by line, so `$` only ever matched the last line and every module above it went untracked. It also skips commented-out lines.

packageRules.description: Every PR needs exactly one bump:* label (pr-label-check.yml), so everything Renovate opens defaults to bump:patch (top-level labels). Updates to the GitHub Actions in our workflows only change CI, not what the pipeline does: group them into one PR per update type, so each round costs a single patch release. They are never automerged, so majors still get a human review.
PATCH bumps of nf-mod-*/nf-sub-* submodules: no propagation. Disabled entirely.
MINOR bumps of nf-mod-*/nf-sub-* submodules: auto-PR, group, and automerge. The post-merge sync workflow updates the submodule pointer; the auto-release workflow bumps this repo's MINOR.
MAJOR bumps of nf-mod-*/nf-sub-* submodules: no automatic propagation. The flag-major-updates workflow in the consuming repo opens a tracking issue instead.
